items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: He played the guitar banjo, the six string banjo. He still does.

ctx.x: Johnny St. Cyris already does that too. He has a six string banjo.

Well you see, yeah he played the guitar banjo. He never played a tenor banjo. He played the guitar banjo, the six string banjo. He still does. He still play that. Yeah. I remember when he left here with Louis Armstrong in there. Yeah, went to Chicago, that's right.
